doc: QA shot list (roadmap P0-03, farm-types spec section 7): items append shots here instead of editing a harness. A shot names the scene that captures it; ids are unique and keep their number prefix.

shots.purpose: Shipped home view (FJORD, 900 m at -17 deg on the first pen) in clear weather: pixel sizes, depression angles and fog transmittance of a tank, the campus and OF1; draw calls and GPU time the farm types add.
Shipped home view, overcast (20 km visibility).
Shipped home view, rain (4.5 km visibility).
Shipped home view, snow (2.5 km visibility).
Shipped home view, storm (2 km visibility).
Shipped home view, sea fog (0.4 km visibility in the layer).
Full-campus framing (spec section 4, 520 m at -40 deg): a grow-out tank's lid ellipse must be at least 40 px tall.
OF1 framing as the read gate set it (220 m at -18 deg; spec revision 2 said 300 m at -22 deg): the 110 m ring fills 25-45% of the frame width and the horizon sits 10-25% from the top.
Before: the spec revision 2 OF1 framing (300 m at -22 deg), kept as the evidence for the change.
The land framing without tank shadows, as spec revision 2's 'LOD1 and beyond cast no shadow' would draw it: every tank there stands in the LOD1 band.
Alternative tried: pad_a at (-470, -1650), shifted east only.
Before: pad_a at the spec revision 2 centre (-700, -1650), kept as the evidence for the move.
The land kit at the spec's land framing (520 m at -40 deg) by day: lid ellipse at least 40 px, dark lids against pale walls dL at least 30 (spec F2-25 accept 5).
The land framing at dusk (ref L2's mood): low sun, hall windows and lid work-lights lit.
The one-lot framing (spec section 4: 380 m at -40 deg) on lot 4: the LOD0/LOD1 hand-over.
The cosmetic pale-lid swatch (#EDEFEF, ref L2) through the shader's lid swap, against the default dark lids (ref L1).
Close look at the LOD0 kit: tanks, walkways, rails, the hall, the orange pipe bridge.
The shipped home view with the kit, overcast: the campuses as landmarks at the mouth (LOD1/LOD2 read).
Hero frame in ref O3's mood: low winter sun on the safety-yellow 12-gon over the open sea, the orange service vessel alongside, the crew boat at the boat landing.
The spec's OF1 framing (section 4: 220 m at -18 deg, set by the F2-18 read gate): the ring fills 25-45% of the frame width; draw calls the unit and its fleet add at LOD0.
Close look at the LOD0 detail: columns with the splash zone, the zig-zag bracing, walkways and rails, the control block, cranes, the net above the water.
After sunset: the nav lanterns flash in sync (1 Hz, Kystverket yellow), the control block's windows and deck lights lit.
The OF1 framing on a grey summer day: the yellow hull and orange vessel stay the only saturation.

Yard / timelapse reveal through the part groups in yard order: Pontoons, Columns, Rings and Bracing done, the Topsides rising through their height band, the Net (and the sliding bulkhead) still to come.
The shipped home view: the unit as a yellow sliver at the mouth (LOD2), the draw calls it and its fleet add against the spec section 5.5 budget (<= 8 opaque + <= 6 shadow).
The offshore fleet in a row beside the unit: the 75 m service vessel visibly shorter than the 110 m ring, the anchor tug (red swatch variant of the same mesh), the 20 m crew boat.

The region view on day 0 of Første sesong: PO 3 picked, the traffic-light dots and the ring on the home area, the capacity card (1 licence, 780 t), the home zone's build refused for cash as text, and Bømlo's licence open for application.

The build dialog before the first harvest: farm type first (Sjø chosen, Land and Hav pointing to their tabs), the preview (cost, cash going negative, running cost, 3 120 t locality, +0 t licence MTB, 8 pens drawn) and the refusal as text with the confirm waiting.
The auction card before the auction: the reserve and its price per tonne, the 7-day length, the free opening, and the state's 2022 and 2024 auction averages.
A running auction four days in: the leading rival by name, the countdown in sim days, every bid newest first with its price per tonne, and the bid field at the minimum bid.
The payoff: the auction won against the rival field, the licence's MTB in PO 4, and the way on to a locality in the won zone.
The build dialog for the won zone (Solund): allowed, the first locality's preview and the confirm ready.
The payoff after the confirm: 'Vis den på fjorden' switches to the fjord with the new locality selected and framed.
The region view at 1280x720: the detail column's zone cards, verdict texts and buttons stay whole and readable.

The end screen on a won Ressursrente (seed 5, harvesting at 4.5 kg): the verdict, the medal with its three distinctions, the campaign note (two scenarios opened), the next scenario first, and the Chart-paper report: key figures, the P&L story with three numbered turning points, where the fish went and the event log.

The scenario picker after that win: Ressursrente with its medal, Trønder-krigen and PO3 Rød Sone opened, the rest padlocked, and the locked Krisemanager's detail naming the wins that open it with Start off.

The end screen on a bankrupt Ressursrente (seed 5, passive): 'Konkurs', the credit limit it fell through and the bank's warning and call days, no medal, 'Prøv igjen' first and 'Fortsett å spille' off; the cash line through the dashed credit limit.

The Finance tab at the bank call (Algekatastrofe, seed 1): the bank card with its stage, the burn and the days to the credit limit, the overdraft interest paid, and the rescue offer's terms with its deadline and the take or decline buttons.
The end screen on a lost Algekatastrofe (seed 1, passive, the rescue loan taken): the scenario's own loss text, the finance distinction missed for the rescue loan, and the report.
The bankrupt end screen at 1280x720: the column's verdict and buttons and the report sheet stay whole and readable (the sheet scrolls).

Første sesong day 0 (seed 7): the guide card in its corner (overline 'Første sesong · steg 1 av 18', 18 dots, the welcome, the salmon 'Gjør dette' callout, 'Klokka står til du har gjort det', 'Vis meg', 'Hopp over') and the pointer's ring and chevron on the Merder rail tab; the card covers neither the tab nor the toasts.
Step 2 on the Merder tab: the ring around the Fôringsplan card (the dropdowns readable inside it), the card moved to a corner where it covers neither the plan nor the pen list.
Step 3: the ring on the 'Avlus ved telling' switch of the Driftsplan card; the switch itself readable through the ring.
Step 6 (a wait step, the clock running at 30×): the info callout 'Vent på dette', the goal bar 'Snittvekt nå … av 4,0 kg' and the ring on the clock strip in the HUD.
Step 7 at 4 kg: the clock held, the ring on the site's 'Høst' button; the card says the planner shows today and 2, 4 and 8 weeks.
Step 9 after the sale: the ring on 'Siste slakterapport' in the pen view, the 'Steg 8 fullført' line on the card.
Step 13 (the loan verb): the clock at 1×, the goal bar 'I banken 3,67 MNOK av 7,06 MNOK', the ring on the Økonomi rail tab (the way to the bank's loan).
Step 16 on the map: the home area picked, the ring on the home zone's 'Bygg lokalitet' in the region view; the card clear of the region view.
'Hopp over' asked first (seed 23, day 0): the confirmation says a skip opens every tab but is no win, 'Hopp over opplæringen' and 'Fortsett opplæringen'; the pointer waits behind it.
The season won by input alone (seed 7, day 294): the end screen's verdict over the finished card ('Første sesong er fullført'), no ring left on screen.

The pause menu's save list: each slot shows its picture of the world (rendered without the UI), the slot name, the scenario ('PO3 Rød Sone') and the local ISO date and time with the game day and the cash; the autosave reads 'Siste autolagring'.
Innstillinger > Spill in Norwegian: the new 'Språk' row (Norsk (bokmål) / English) above Autolagring, every label from translation keys.
The same tab after picking English: the menu redraws in English at once (Settings, Audio, Graphics, Gameplay, Accessibility).
Settings > Tilgjengelighet with Høykontrast ticked: the high-contrast theme applies at once (opaque panels, white text, bright borders, a 3 px yellow focus ring).
The game with high contrast on: the HUD, the tab rail and the dashboard on the high-contrast Ink and Chart surfaces over the fjord.
The main menu's load list over the live fjord: the same slots with their pictures, scenario and ISO time.
The fjord tab as the first save ('Vårutsett 2027', day 40) is made: the slot's picture in 44_save_slots should show this view without the HUD.
The carved pad_a (Storholmen) at the land framing (520 m at -40 deg) unbuilt: the flat +3.6 m pad reads as heath on the strandflat, its rim falls to the sea as rock fill; no tree or naust on it.
The same framing with the pads blasted (pad_state 1): blasted granite #6B7378 on the pad and its cut faces; its mean colour differs from the heath frame by dE at least 10 (F2-19 accept 6).
pad_b (Skjærvika) at the land framing, unbuilt: the cut face into the hillside to the north-east, the rock fill to the fairway.
pad_b blasted: granite on the pad and the cut face.
pad_delta (Elveøyra) on the head delta, unbuilt: raised from +2.5 m to +3.6 m and filled out over the delta front.
pad_delta blasted.
The shipped home view with the carved, unbuilt pads at the mouth: they read as low heath-covered strandflat, not as flat rectangles.
The home view with the pads blasted.

One HFS lot built on pad_a through the engine's verbs, at the one-lot framing (380 m at -40 deg). Site works, blasting (the land lane's first phase, at 30%): the granite spreads across the heath in patches over the campus's ground; nothing stands yet.

One HFS lot built on pad_a through the engine's verbs, at the one-lot framing (380 m at -40 deg). Site works, foundations (85%): the blasted yard with the tanks' concrete ring foundations and the roads.

One HFS lot built on pad_a through the engine's verbs, at the one-lot framing (380 m at -40 deg). Tank rings (50%): the walls half up, open-topped; no hall, no quay or bridge yet (F2-20 accept 2: against the sea works, pHash distance at least 9).
One HFS lot built on pad_a through the engine's verbs, at the one-lot framing (380 m at -40 deg). Treatment hall (60%): the tank walls up without lids, the hall bays and the dark harvest hall rising.

One HFS lot built on pad_a through the engine's verbs, at the one-lot framing (380 m at -40 deg). Sea works (60%): the halls up, the quay, the intake basin and the orange pipe bridge rising (F2-20 accept 2: pHash distance to the tank rings at least 9).
The tank-rings state stood again after the sea works (wave4b review): its campus hash against p2's is the metric's own noise in the run, read against the p2 vs p4 difference.

One HFS lot built on pad_a through the engine's verbs, at the one-lot framing (380 m at -40 deg). First tanks (50%): the utilities rising; the first tanks get their lids at the phase's end (the engine hands them over).

One HFS lot built on pad_a through the engine's verbs, at the one-lot framing (380 m at -40 deg). Completion (50%): the engine has handed over the first six grow-out tanks (lids on, feeders), the rest stand open-topped.

The QA set's HFS lot (built through the engine, its project complete) at the land framing (520 m at -40 deg) by day: the lot's grid of dark lids between the hall, the dark harvest hall, the orange pipe bridge from the quay, roads and aprons on the blasted granite; the drawn tanks equal the engine's; draw calls it adds.
The campus at dusk (ref L2's mood): low sun, the hall windows, the roof lights and the lid work-lights lit by the presenter's dusk lighting.
Ref L2's wow from low over the sound at dusk: the lit campus against the low sun's sky and its reflection, the orange bridge, the lid work-lights and hall windows on.
Closer on the lot: LOD0 tanks with walkways, rails and the feeders' rotors, the process hall, the pipe bridge over the lot road.
The QA set's post-smolt site on pad_delta (two modules): their Ø16 m tanks under the lean-to bays, the river intake, on the head delta.
The QA set's OF1-class unit on off_1 (contracted through the engine), low winter sun. Yard contract: the unit is still paper; four yellow survey buoys mark its slot.
The QA set's OF1-class unit on off_1 (contracted through the engine), low winter sun. Hull at the yard: at the slot the moorings are pre-laid, their eight pick-up buoys in four pairs.
The QA set's OF1-class unit on off_1 (contracted through the engine), low winter sun. Voyage: the finished unit approaches from the open sea behind one tug.
The QA set's OF1-class unit on off_1 (contracted through the engine), low winter sun. Tow: three anchor tugs bring the unit in toward its slot.
The QA set's OF1-class unit on off_1 (contracted through the engine), low winter sun. Mooring: the unit on station, the three tugs at the anchor bearings.
The QA set's OF1-class unit on off_1 (contracted through the engine), low winter sun. Commissioning: the crew boat at the boat landing.

The QA set's OF1-class unit on off_1 at the OF1 framing (220 m at -18 deg) in low winter sun (ref O3): the safety-yellow 12-gon on deep blue with the orange DP service vessel at its walk-to-work landing; draw calls it adds.
Ref O3's angle: the unit and its service vessel from the sun side, the coast low on the horizon.

The OF1-class unit and its service vessel alone at the unit's own framing (220 m, -18 deg): the draw calls and shadow draws they add where their LOD0 and shadows are drawn (the home view's budget cannot see them; wave4b review).
The shipped home view with the QA set: the campus as a landmark at the mouth, the OF1 unit a yellow sliver beyond it; draw calls the presenter adds at the home view.
Spec section 5 budget at the shipped home view: the draw calls one OF1-class unit with its service vessel adds (<= 8 opaque + <= 6 shadow).

The full 4-lot campus (grown lot by lot through the engine) at the land framing (520 m at -40 deg): four lots in two rows filling pad_a, the utilities behind; the draw calls the campus alone adds there, its LOD0 triangles (spec section 5: <= 250 k) and the shadow rule.
Spec section 5 budget at the shipped home view (the P0-04 view): the draw calls the full 4-lot campus alone adds (<= 20 opaque + <= 16 shadow).

A 2-lot HFS campus on pad_b (Skjærvika) at the land framing: the orange pipe bridge runs from the quay between the intake basin and the dark harvest hall, clear of both (wave4b review: it ran through the hall on this pad); the engine's tanks, no layout clash.
pad_b's campus closer in the afternoon sun: the bridge's spans between the basin and the hall, the hall 10 m off the bridge, the apron from the hall to the quay (wave4b review).

The full 4-lot campus on pad_a by day at the camera's own land framing (G's Land bookmark: -40 deg from off the quay edge, as near as shows it whole): the grid of dark lids, the process halls between the rows, the dark harvest hall, the orange pipe bridge from the quay (ref L1). Checks: every corner of the campus in the frame; the bridge's orange in the campus's box.

The campus in the blue hour (the sun 3.5 deg under the horizon: Blåtime, ref L2's dusk) from low over the sound toward the afterglow (340 m at -9 deg): the hall windows, the roof lights, the lids' work-light pools and the yard's lamps and pools of light. Checks: lit pixels with the lights held off and on (F2-23 night lighting), the sky's blue-violet.

A second HFS site going up on pad_b (the tank rings 62 % up, open-topped, on blasted granite) at the camera's own land framing of it: construction as world state (spec §6.3). Checks: every corner in the frame; its tanks drawn open (none whole) against the engine's.

The OF1-class unit in low winter sun (ref O3) at the camera's own OF1 framing (G's Hav bookmark: 220 m at -18 deg from the open sea, looking in toward the fjord mouth and its hills): the safety-yellow ring on deep blue, the orange service vessel alongside. Checks (spec accept 4): hull-yellow pixels >= 1.5 % of the frame, the open water's mean saturation <= 0.35; the sea chip reads the engine's Hs.

The unit at its framing in a storm on a 4.8 m sea (wind sea 3.9 m and a 2.8 m swell at 12.5 s, staged as the open sea's target): long heavy swell under the chop, whitecaps, rain, the unit heaving on the drawn water and its Ink sea chip. Checks: the drawn open sea's Hs and swell, foam on the water, the chip on screen.

The shipped home view, overcast: the campus a landmark band on the strandflat at the mouth, the OF1 unit a yellow sliver beyond it (spec §5.5 rule 1). Checks (spec accept 5): OF1 hull-hue pixels >= 200; the campus silhouette's lightness at least 15 L* off the strandflat round it; no chip (the unit reads by itself).
The home view in rain (4.5 km): the fog hides the unit, so its status chip shows over it (spec §5.5 rule 2, accept 5).
The home view in snow (2.5 km): the unit's status chip shows (spec §5.5 rule 2, accept 5).
The home view in a storm (2 km): the unit's status chip shows (spec §5.5 rule 2, accept 5).

The land first sight at 1.6 s (spec §6.4: Blåtime dusk; a 4 s timelapse from the bare pad, the camera low over the quay along the orange bridge to the tanks as the lid work-lights come on, up to the -40 deg framing; the card with 'Lagre bilde').

The land first sight at 6.8 s (spec §6.4: Blåtime dusk; a 4 s timelapse from the bare pad, the camera low over the quay along the orange bridge to the tanks as the lid work-lights come on, up to the -40 deg framing; the card with 'Lagre bilde').

The land first sight at 11.2 s (spec §6.4: Blåtime dusk; a 4 s timelapse from the bare pad, the camera low over the quay along the orange bridge to the tanks as the lid work-lights come on, up to the -40 deg framing; the card with 'Lagre bilde').

The land first sight at 17.6 s (spec §6.4: Blåtime dusk; a 4 s timelapse from the bare pad, the camera low over the quay along the orange bridge to the tanks as the lid work-lights come on, up to the -40 deg framing; the card with 'Lagre bilde').

The offshore first sight at 1.6 s (spec §6.4: low winter sun; the unit rises part by part, the camera from behind the orange service vessel up to the low oblique framing of the yellow ring, the fjord mouth and its hills on the horizon, a wellboat coming in; the card).

The offshore first sight at 6.2 s (spec §6.4: low winter sun; the unit rises part by part, the camera from behind the orange service vessel up to the low oblique framing of the yellow ring, the fjord mouth and its hills on the horizon, a wellboat coming in; the card).

The offshore first sight at 11.0 s (spec §6.4: low winter sun; the unit rises part by part, the camera from behind the orange service vessel up to the low oblique framing of the yellow ring, the fjord mouth and its hills on the horizon, a wellboat coming in; the card).

The offshore first sight at 17.4 s (spec §6.4: low winter sun; the unit rises part by part, the camera from behind the orange service vessel up to the low oblique framing of the yellow ring, the fjord mouth and its hills on the horizon, a wellboat coming in; the card).
The land first sight with reduced motion (spec §6.4): a still of the campus at its framing in the blue hour with the card, after a 2 s cross-fade from the frame the player was on.
The teaser at 2 s (spec §6.1 item 1): beyond the mouth a parody rival's yellow hull comes over the horizon under tow, three anchor tugs ahead.
The teaser at 6 s: the tow crosses the horizon beyond the mouth, the camera panning with it.
The teaser at 10 s: the tow heads out toward hav_1; the news card ("Fortsett" only: no build offered).
The teaser with reduced motion: a still of the tow beyond the mouth with the news card, after a 2 s cross-fade from the frame the player was on.
